lines.text: Dawn light slips through the lace curtains of Granny Wren's kitchen, gilding the flour-dusted counters and the great brick oven that dominates the room. lines.speaker: Granny Wren
lines.text: (jerking awake) Oh! Pip, dumpling! You're... you're still here. Still awake.

lines.speaker: Granny Wren
lines.text: The Moon Loaf. We must bake it before the next moonrise, or the sleep becomes forever. The recipe... I've forgotten so much. The ingredients are scattered. The oven... she trails off, gaze drifting to the cold hearth

lines.text: (bursting through the back door, satchel bouncing) Special delivery for the Wren residence! One courier, slightly windblown, bearing urgent news and absolutely terrible jokes! ...Also, why is it so quiet? Did I miss a very intense nap time?
